transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get today's pre-receipt huddle started. We've got tomorrow's inbound delivery -- one palletized lot of generator housings and one lot of communications cable reels -- and I need to publish final lane assignments before this meeting wraps. The draft plan currently shows all three staging lanes as interchangeable with no special receiving controls listed. Before I lock in assignments, I need to hear from each of you: are there any changes or factors affecting tomorrow's receiving plan that I should know about? Warehouse ops NCO, movement control officer -- what are you seeing on your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, there's a critical factor you need to know before locking in lane assignments. This morning I confirmed that only Lane 2 has a current floor-load certification for the 1,800-kilogram generator-housing pallet. The certification is filed in the warehouse binder, but it has not been added to the yard diagram yet -- which is why the draft plan still shows all three lanes as interchangeable. The generator-housing pallet must go to Lane 2; the other lanes are not certified for that weight.
